correctness.rationale: For all four positive real weights and common p in (0,1), normalize/order weights. Every subset-sum collision is a dot product with one of 40 normals in {-1,0,1}^4 modulo sign. Intersections of up to three normals and ordered-simplex boundary planes yield 12 distinct exact-rational vertices and exactly 23 attainable positive collision coefficient patterns. Independently executed classify4.py and verified 40 normals, 12 vertices, 3327 subspaces, 23 patterns, all with representatives <=8. Every resulting probability q_s(p) is a four-term Bernstein polynomial; H″=-Σ_s (q″log q+(q′)^2/q). For 0<p<=1e-4, q_s>=p^4, Σ|q″|<=192, and Fisher-information lower bound 4(1-p)^2/p imply strict negative curvature. On [1e-4,1/2] the supplied complete outward-rounded mpmath.iv interval checker rigorously encloses H″ for each pattern, bisecting undecided boxes until strict negative upper bounds; independently ran full code with mpmath 1.3.0 and reproduced 1,129 visited interval nodes across 23 patterns, maximum depth five. Symmetry H(p)=H(1-p) gives (1/2,1), endpoint continuity strict concavity on [0,1]. Computational continuum certificates are substantive proof ingredients, not finite sample extrapolation.
